reviews.text: I didn’t see any significant difference in my skin, it’s moisturising but doesn’t seem to do anything else, its not bad but I would not recommend it
reviews.zh: 皮膚上冇見到明顯分別，係有保濕但似乎冇其他功效，唔算差但我唔會推薦

reviews.text: I love the carrot Carotene toner pads so much so i had a feeling this would also be a favorite. I really like it and that it comfortably fits into both morning and night routines easily. Provides wonderful moisturization just like the toner pads do.
reviews.zh: 我已經超鍾意紅蘿蔔Carotene爽膚水pad，所以都有信心呢個都會係心頭好。真係好鍾意，無論係日頭定夜晚都好容易加入護膚程序。保濕效果一流，同爽膚水pad一樣。

reviews.text: Se ha vuelto mi favorito. Me encanta como me deja la piel, me la deja súper humectada y no se me ha brotado la piel. Llevo más de un mes usándolo y los efectos han sido súper positivos. Ya compré mi segundo pote.
reviews.zh: 已經變咗我最鍾意嘅一款。好鍾意佢對皮膚嘅效果，皮膚變得超級保濕，而且冇爆瘡。用咗超過一個月，效果超級正面。已經買咗第二樽。

reviews.text: Soothing, hydrating, and has a subtle smell that I love. I use this in tandem with the toner and cream from the same line. My every day, holy grail routine
reviews.zh: 舒緩、保濕，味道好淡好鍾意。我會同同一系列嘅爽膚水同乳霜一齊用。已經成為我每日嘅神級護膚程序

reviews.text: 今バズっているニンジンのパックのセラムタイプということで購入しました。ニンジンのセラムということで、ニンジンっぽい匂いがするのかと思いましたが、そんなことはなく、使いやすいです。軽めのテクスチャーなので、ベタつかずに使えるので朝晩選ばずに使えるのがとてもいいです。
reviews.zh: 因為見到而家大熱嘅紅蘿蔔面膜有出精華液款所以買咗。雖然係紅蘿蔔精華，但以為會有紅蘿蔔味，原來又唔係，好易用。質地偏輕，所以唔黏笠，日頭夜晚都可以用，呢一點真係好正。

reviews.text: the smell is very luxurious, not too strong or noticeable. It's very soothing on the skin as well and hydrating.
reviews.zh: 味道好高級，唔算太濃或者太突出。搽喺皮膚上好舒緩，而且保濕。

reviews.text: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Moisture Effector has become a beloved addition to my skincare routine. Its lightweight and hydrating formula deliver visible results, leaving my skin feeling nourished, refreshed, and radiant. I highly recommend this effector to anyone looking to boost their skin's hydration and glow. With SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Moisture Effector, achieving healthy and luminous skin is within reach.
reviews.zh: SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Moisture Effector已經成為我護膚程序中不可或缺嘅一部分。佢輕薄又保濕嘅配方帶嚟明顯效果，用完皮膚感覺有營養、清爽又充滿光澤。我高度推薦呢款effector畀任何想加強皮膚保濕同光澤嘅人。用SKINFOOD Carrot Carotene Moisture Effector，健康有光澤嘅皮膚觸手可及。

reviews.text:
Carrot-Infused Nourishment (5/5):
The standout feature of this Moisture Effector was its carrot-infused formula. With consistent use, I observed a noticeable improvement in my skin's overall hydration and suppleness. The effector seemed to deliver a dose of nourishment, leaving my skin feeling deeply moisturized and revitalized.

Radiant Glow (4.5/5):
The Carrot Carotene Moisture Effector lived up to its promise of delivering a radiant glow. The carrot-infused formula contributed to a healthy and luminous complexion. With each application, my skin appeared more revitalized, creating a natural radiance that was both subtle and enchanting.

Hydration Reservoir (5/5):
While focusing on radiance, the effector also served as a hydration reservoir for my skin. It maintained a consistent level of moisture throughout the day, eliminating any dryness or tightness. The effector's ability to combine radiance with long-lasting hydration made it a standout product in my skincare routine.
reviews.zh:
蘿蔔精華滋養（5/5）：
呢支 Moisture Effector 最突出嘅就係佢嘅蘿蔔精華配方。持續用咗一段時間之後，我觀察到皮膚嘅整體保濕度同柔軟度有明顯改善。支 effector 似乎為皮膚注入咗一劑滋養，皮膚感覺深層保濕、煥然一新。

光澤感（4.5/5）：
Carrot Carotene Moisture Effector 真係做到佢承諾嘅光澤感。蘿蔔精華配方令膚色更健康、更有光澤。每次用完，皮膚睇落更煥活，散發出自然、淡雅又迷人嘅光采。

保濕水庫（5/5）：
喺主打光澤感嘅同時，呢支 effector 仲充當咗我皮膚嘅保濕水庫。佢全日都維持到穩定嘅保濕度，消除任何乾燥或繃緊感。支 effector 能夠將光澤感同持久保濕結合埋一齊，喺我嘅護膚程序入面真係脫穎而出。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
